text: あとは…　ニシキに　おしえとく　ことが　あるから　もすこし　さんぽ　しといて！

structure.jp: ニシキに　おしえとく　ことが　あるから
structure.en: because there are things I need to tell Celio

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: おく after a て-form says you do something ahead of time, or for the time being. とく is the short spoken form of ておく. おしえとく = 'tell (him) in advance'; さんぽ　しといて = 'go walk around for now'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ニシキに　おしえとく　こと
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. ニシキに　おしえとく　こと = 'things to tell Celio'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a sentence gives the reason for what comes next. ことが　あるから = 'because there are things'.
